note: CALIBRATION corpus, not a discovery corpus. Ground truth is solid and hand-verified over fifty years. Its job is to fail loudly if the pipeline is broken. Do not report novel MUSes from this corpus as findings without a proof-theorist reading them.

mustFind.note: Fifteen years after Seetapun. Together these place RT^2_2 outside the Big Five.

THE test. Treating 'Ramsey's theorem' as one statement with one strength erases the whole point. If the extractor aliases rt22 to rt_n_k this MUS vanishes and the run silently passes while being wrong.
Trivial arity-2 sanity check on the extractor.

mustNotFind.why: All the standard equivalences are jointly true. A contradiction here means the encoding is treating distinct subsystems as one predicate, or distinct theorems as one.

This is RT^2_2's actual location. Strictly between RCA_0 and ACA_0 while incomparable with WKL_0 is a consistent position in a partial order. Reporting it as contradictory means the encoding assumed a linear order.
Two named subsystems. Distinct, not contradictory. Tripwire.

openQuestions.note: The Big Five are linearly ordered but RT^2_2 makes the full picture a partial order. FOL encoding must not assume totality of the implication relation. If it does, mustNotFind.rt22_position_is_coherent will fire and that is the pipeline's fault, not the corpus's.
Unlike the other corpora, a surplus MUS here is almost certainly an encoding bug. This corpus is where surplus findings are a NEGATIVE signal.
